newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOVERNMENT EXTENDS $10 MLN GUARANTEE TO UBS.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT EXTENDS $10 MLN GUARANTEE TO UBS.

text.p: The Lithuanian government decided on Wednesday to extend a state guarantee for a $10 million loan to Lithuanian Gas from Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS), the government's press office said.
The government last year guaranteed a six-month $10 million credit from UBS to Lithuanian Gas at LIBOR +2.0 percent to pay for the company's gas supplies.
The term of the state's guarantee was due to expire at the end of May.

"Taking into consideration the favourable terms of the contract and the agreement of UBS to prolong the contract on the same terms, the government decided to extend the state's guarantee for six months," the government said in a statement.
The term of the state's guarantee will expire on December 27, 1997.
